minutes_text:
VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2023
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, ROOM 204
  LONG BEACH, 5:00 PM

Jesse Blanco, Chair  Juanita Doplemore, Commissioner
Lance Santiago, Vice Chair  Kenneth Osborn, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Blanco called the meeting to order at 5:18 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith

Commissioners Absent: Antes, Shaknovich

Also present: Jessica Schumer, Deputy Director of Health and Human Services, Erica Valencia-
Adachi, Collective Impact Bureau Manager, Gina Overholt, Coordinator, Joey King, Veteran,
James Schotter, Veteran, Jesse Soria, People of the Earth Krew, Antawnette Blade, Veteran.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Chair Blanco led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-24966  Recommendation to Approve Minutes for September 13, 2023.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Osborn, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Blanco, Doplemore, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 2  Contreras, Smith
  Absent: 3  Antes, Osorio Santiago, Shaknovich

2.  23-25097  Recommendation to discuss 2023 Long Beach Veterans Day Celebration.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osborn, seconded by Blanco, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Page 1 of 2
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMITTEE MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2023
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, ROOM 204
  LONG BEACH, 5:00 PM

  Yes:  5  Blanco, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Antes, Osorio Santiago, Shaknovich

  G. Overholt reported on event planning activities and led a site map review. The
  new layout for this year’s event will encompass the 34-foot stage, 36 vendors in the
  Veterans and Community Resources Fair, including mobile vendors (the Health
  Department’s flu vaccination clinic, LB Police Dept., LB Fire Dept., and Homeless
  Services), the giant obstacle course, Kids Zone, beer garden, and food truck. The
  event also includes live music with the Satin Dollz and Knyght Ryder, a DJ/event
  MC (Mr. Quick), a Veterans Recognition Ceremony and five flyovers, presented by
  Long Beach City College. A data collection team (from the Health Department)
  developed a survey which they will administrate during the event to Veterans and
  Veterans’ family members (as well as post a QR code so survey may be completed
  online). Commissioners provided input on the scope and content of the survey. Ken
  Osborn is lead on the Office of Veterans Support/Veterans Commission booth, and
  Antawnette Blade is a lead on Resources Fair check-in and set-up. Lakewood High
  School will provide up to 10 volunteers. Long Beach Veterans Day Committee is a
  food truck sponsor.

PUBLIC COMMENT

No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

VA Long Beach Healthcare System will host a Veterans Day event on Friday, November 10, from 10
a.m. to 3 p.m, featuring a car show, motorcycles, food, music and Veterans organizations.

Future Agenda items were suggested, including the selection of a new Commission chair, updating
the Veterans Strategic Plan, and regularly documenting and reporting on what the new Office has
accomplished.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Blanco adjourned the meeting at 6:14 p.m.
